column1: # Changes a migration makes to existing data on purpose. tests/upgrade-test.sh fails on any other
# change to a row, a column or a table the previous release had. One line per change, tab-separated:
# An entry counts only in an upgrade that runs its migration; keep it until that migration is in a
# release, then it may go. Never add one to make a failing upgrade pass without reading the migration:
# a dropped column with data in it is lost data, and the reason must say why losing it is right.
